description: Land Title Settlement Department - Alankulama (Block 01), Nachchaduwa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110611 (24/120078)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title registration, cadastral mapping, and determination of land ownership in various villages of Anuradhapura District. The content falls under the specialized Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land registration, title claims, and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
